title: TypeScript type error with Express Request and AuthenticatedRequest
description: Controller expects AuthenticatedRequest (custom type with user property) but Express route handlers expect standard Request type. Type mismatch causes compilation error when wiring controller to route.

resolution.approach: Use wrapper function pattern: (req, res) => controller(req as AuthenticatedRequest, res)
resolution.rationale: Maintains type safety without Express type conflicts. Wrapper function allows type assertion at the boundary.

prevention: Document: Use wrapper pattern for Express routes with custom request types. Standard pattern for auth middleware integration.
